messages:
Alice Chen: Bringing up new model 'Astra-40B' for hosted + dedicated. Proposing quant plan and quality gates. Target p50 latency ~80ms, cost goal ~3x savings vs fp16. Thoughts?

Ben Ortiz: Baseline fp16 p50 ~72ms on A100. Cost baseline noted. Primary risk is instruction-following regressions.

Carla Mendez: Agree. Suggest we prioritize chat instruction evals and extractive QA. Also include an embeddings drift check for rerank pipelines.

Mateo Salazar: Proposal: three-stage funnel
1) fp16 smoke (sanity + perf)
2) PTQ int8 (per-channel, per-layer fallback list)
3) FP8 hybrid (only attention kernels) if int8 fails quality
Calib corpus: 10k tokens sampled from instruction+qa+longform.

Dave K.: Add a "sensitivity ladder" for calibration runs: 1k / 5k / 10k samples. Measure delta-PPL, Exact Match (EM) for QA, and conv-turn BLEU for chat. If delta-PPL < 1.25 and EM drop < 2% -> pass.

Ben Ortiz: For int8 PTQ: use per-channel scales, asymmetric quant where needed. Keep KV cache in fp16 for safety. Also plan to export gguf and a quant-validated Triton profile.

Alice Chen: Quick config sketch (for the runbook):
```
quant_plan: int8-ptq
calibration: stratified: [instruction, qa, longform]
calib_samples: [1000,5000,10000]
per_layer_fallback: []
kv_dtype: fp16
eval_sets: [instr_chat_v2, qa_squad_shot, embeddings_probe]
regression_thresholds: {delta_ppl:1.25,em_drop_pct:2.0,embed_cos_drop:0.03}
```

redwood-evals-bot: Initial int8 PTQ run (1k samples) completed.
Metrics: delta_PPL=1.18, EM_drop=1.7%, embedding_cos_drop=0.015, throughput +2.8x, p50=68ms

Carla Mendez: Not bad for 1k. Need to see 5k and 10k. Also sanity-check hallucination rate on convo set.

Mateo Salazar: If 5k stays within thresholds, we can create an _int8_ candidate and shadow-serve for 24h. Fallback map: route 5% traffic to fp16 if QA/SLAs are strict.

Ben Ortiz: For shadowing, add routing policy by customer tier. Enterprise customers default to fp16 unless explicit sign-off. PLG can go int8 candidate.

Dave K.: Action items:
- Ben: run 5k and 10k calibration + export gguf (due Tue 10:00 PST)
- Carla: run hallucination and embedding drift checks on 5k (due Tue 18:00 PST)
- Mateo: prepare fallback routing rules and canary config (due Wed)

Alice Chen: Also note: if int8 fails at 10k, try per-layer FP16 fallback for top 3 sensitive layers, or attempt FP8 hybrid for attention blocks.

Ben Ortiz: Quick question: what error budget for latency regressions during canary? +10% p50?

Alice Chen: Keep canary p50 <= +15% and errors < 0.5% absolute.

Carla Mendez: I'll log the calibration artifacts to model bucket and add eval manifests in the runbook.

Ben Ortiz: ok, starting 5k now. Will post gguf artifacts and eval report.

Dave K.: :thumbsup: 

Alice Chen: Thanks team. Ping here with results. If 5k looks good we'll schedule a 24h shadow deploy.
